name: Pipedrive
claude_quote: Your app is live and can be shared with any company in Pipedrive via its direct, unlisted installation link.
gemini_note: A free developer sandbox account is available for building and testing integrations. API access is included in all paid plans. While public and unlisted apps require a marketplace review, a developer can create a 'private' multi-tenant OAuth app that does not require vendor approval.

name: Pipedrive
claude_quote: Public OAuth2 docs, free developer sandbox account on request, and unlisted private apps can connect other companies without marketplace review.
gemini_note: null

name: Zendesk
claude_quote: Zendesk now runs a first-party MCP server, and it lives on your own subdomain ... https://<your-subdomain>.zendesk.com/api/mcp
gemini_note: reminia/zendesk-mcp-server (https://github.com/reminia/zendesk-mcp-server)

name: Twilio
claude_quote: Use your API key as the username and your API key secret as the password.
gemini_note: Twilio offers Twilio Connect, an OAuth 2.0-based solution specifically for multi-tenant applications. This allows a third-party application to securely access a customer's Twilio account data and perform actions on their behalf, with billing handled directly by Twilio. While standard account-level OAuth apps are single-tenant, Twilio Connect is the designated multi-tenant approach. Another method for multi-tenancy involves programmatically creating subaccounts for each tenant under a main account.

name: Twilio
claude_quote: Twilio MCP server (Public Beta, docs search/retrieve); Twilio Labs also publishes github.com/twilio-labs/mcp exposing Twilio APIs as MCP tools
gemini_note: The `twilio/ai` GitHub repository contains tools and skills for AI agents but is not an MCP server. No official MCP server was found.

name: Aircall
claude_quote: OAuth credentials - If you haven't received them yet, apply to the Tech Partner program
gemini_note: Obtaining OAuth credentials for a public, multi-tenant app to be listed on the marketplace requires applying to the Technology Partner Program. However, any Aircall admin on a paid plan can self-serve generate API keys for private integrations without needing partnership approval. The 7-day free trial provides access to both Essentials and Professional plan features, but with significant limitations.

name: Meta Ads
claude_quote: Meta shipped an official MCP server and CLI on April 29, 2026 ... endpoint https://mcp.facebook.com/ads
gemini_note: Meta provides an official MCP server, launched in April 2026, at https://mcp.facebook.com/ads. It allows AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to connect directly to Meta ad accounts for management and analysis using OAuth for authentication.

name: Klaviyo
claude_quote: Free account, unlisted OAuth apps can connect customer accounts without review, well-documented REST API.
gemini_note: Access to the Webhooks API for managing system webhooks requires becoming a Klaviyo app partner or purchasing the 'Advanced KDP' add-on.

name: Shopify
claude_quote: Public distribution - Can be installed on multiple Shopify stores - requires Shopify approval; Custom distribution - Installed on a single Shopify store ... No approval
gemini_note: Any developer can sign up for the Shopify Partner Program for free to get API credentials and create unlimited free development stores for testing. However, for an app to be installed on multiple merchant stores, it must be distributed as a "Public" app (either listed or unlisted) and pass Shopify's app review process. Custom apps are limited to a single merchant or a single Plus Organization.

name: Shopify
claude_quote: Storefront MCP server lets your AI agent handle shopping tasks for the selected store
gemini_note: Shopify provides official MCP servers: the Storefront MCP is enabled by default on stores for AI shopping agents, and the Dev MCP is a local tool for developers. Additionally, community-built MCP servers exist that wrap the Admin API for store management tasks.

name: MrScraper
claude_quote: create an API token for authentication (MCP: MCP_MRSCRAPER_API_KEY sent as a bearer token)
gemini_note: A static API token is passed as a bearer token in the Authorization header (e.g., Authorization: Bearer API_TOKEN).

name: Waterfall.io
claude_quote: sign up to get 100 free credits ... Every user gets an API key after signing up
gemini_note: API credentials require booking a demo and coordinating with sales/engineering teams; no self-serve free tier or trial.

name: Waterfall.io
claude_quote: No MCP page in docs index
gemini_note: A community-maintained Apify actor exposes the Waterfall.io API via an MCP server; no official vendor-maintained server was found.

name: Waterfall.io
claude_quote: Public docs with x-api-key auth and self-serve signup with free credits (usage-based prepaid thereafter).
gemini_note: API access is entirely gated behind a sales-led onboarding process; developers cannot self-serve sign up or instantly obtain credentials.

name: Vercel
claude_quote: Creates and returns a new authentication token for the currently authenticated user
gemini_note: The free "Hobby" plan provides API access for personal, non-commercial use only. Any commercial use requires upgrading to a paid "Pro" plan. A developer can create a Vercel account, generate personal access tokens, and create OAuth 2.0 applications for "Sign in with Vercel" under any plan.

name: Vercel
claude_quote: Public REST API with Bearer tokens/OAuth integrations available on free Hobby accounts plus official MCP.
gemini_note: While API credentials can be obtained on the free tier, any commercial use of the API is prohibited by Vercel's terms of service for the "Hobby" plan, requiring an upgrade to a paid "Pro" plan.

name: Plaid
claude_quote: Plaid has two environments: Sandbox and Production. The Sandbox environment supports only test Items.
gemini_note: Developers can sign up instantly via the Plaid Dashboard to obtain API keys for the Sandbox environment. For new US/CA teams (created on or after April 15, 2026), a free Trial plan is available, which is auto-approved for most developers and supports up to 10 Production Items (real bank connections). The old "Limited Production" mode is no longer available for new US/CA signups after that date. Moving to a full paid plan for unlimited usage requires submitting an application for Production access.

name: Plaid
claude_quote: Free self-serve Sandbox keys, but real data needs Production access approval and per-end-user Link flow to obtain access_tokens.
gemini_note: A developer can sign up for a free Sandbox instantly and also get auto-approved for a "Trial plan" that allows connecting up to 10 real bank accounts at no cost. This provides a clear path to begin building and testing with live data without a mandatory manual review or payment.

name: Paygent Connect
claude_quote: entering the username and password issued by their gateway provider
gemini_note: Any developer can sign up at paygent.to or withpaygent.com to get an API key. A free tier is available with a defined spend cap (e.g., "$5/period total cap") and token limits. The pricing page on withpaygent.com also shows a free plan for up to "10k events per month".

name: Paygent Connect
claude_quote: No MCP server found in searches for Paygent / Paygent Connect
gemini_note: The first-pass record incorrectly included information about an MCP server from paygentcommerce.com, which is a separate, early-access product focused on agentic commerce. The public paygent.to and withpaygent.com services for cost management do not have an MCP server.

name: Paygent Connect
claude_quote: Could not locate public Paygent-specific developer docs; NMI-style gateway credentials require a merchant account issued via a gateway provider/reseller.
gemini_note: none

name: Otter AI
claude_quote: All access is OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions
gemini_note: The Public REST API, available to Enterprise customers, uses static personal bearer tokens. The official remote MCP server, available on all plans, uses OAuth2.

name: Otter AI
claude_quote: Otter offers a public API for Enterprise customers. To get started, contact your Otter account manager to enable access.
gemini_note: While the full REST API and webhooks are restricted to the Enterprise plan, Otter provides an official, self-serve MCP server that is available on all plans, including the free 'Basic' tier. This allows developers to build integrations without needing to contact sales.

name: Otter AI
claude_quote: REST API is Enterprise-only (account manager), but the official OAuth remote MCP server (reportedly all plans incl. free) can be wrapped.
gemini_note: While the full REST API and webhooks are restricted to the Enterprise plan, Otter provides an official, self-serve MCP server that is available on all plans, including the free 'Basic' tier. This allows developers to build integrations without needing to contact sales.

name: YouTube Transcript
claude_quote: Authorization: Bearer API_KEY
gemini_note: The REST API uses an API key passed as a bearer token in the Authorization header. The MCP server supports both API Key authentication and OAuth 2.1 for connecting with AI agents like Claude (Dynamic Client Registration) and ChatGPT (Static Client Registration with Client ID/Secret).
